comments.text: Best hitching spot for going north. Stand on the beginning of the highway (somewhere around the big ass gate). Plenty of space for cars to pull up. You can get there by taking local bus number 19 or a songthaew from Talat Sao

comments.text: If you're planning to go to Vang Vieng, hitchhiking on the highway might be your best bet. While there may be fewer drivers than on the other route, you could get lucky and catch a direct ride to Vang Vieng. I only waited two minutes before getting picked up. The signs in Lao are really helpful.
